dct_description_sm: The Ipsos Canada 2014 Ontario Provincial Election Call Poll is an online survey held between June 6-11, 2014, during the 41st Ontario General Election. An online survey tool was used to examine voter attitudes and preferences in the 41st Ontario general election. Respondents provide information regarding government and party leader preferences, vote intention, and their predicted election results. This study has a sample of 1,991 respondents.
